title: Rahoton Shekara-shekara na 2025
key_sentences: A shekarar 2025, ƙungiyarmu ta taimaka wa iyalai fiye da dubu goma sha biyu a yankuna uku.
An yi wa yara fiye da dubu shida allurar rigakafi.
More than six thousand children were vaccinated.
Muna aiki tare da ma'aikatar lafiya ta ƙasa, da shugabannin gargajiya, da ƙungiyoyin mata.
Yankin Maradi ne ya fi yawan mutane saboda sabbin cibiyoyi biyu da aka buɗe a can.
Kashi saba'in da biyar cikin ɗari an kashe su kai tsaye a ayyukan filin.
Duk da haka, mun ci gaba da aiki ta hanyar ma'aikatan lafiya na al'umma da ke zaune a ƙauyukan.
Ba tare da goyon bayansu ba, waɗannan nasarori ba za su samu ba.

list_items.text: Horar da ungozoma ɗari da arba'in a kan haihuwa lafiya.
Gina rijiyoyin burtsatse guda takwas kusa da cibiyoyin lafiya.
Rarraba gidajen sauro dubu tara ga iyalai masu ƙananan yara.
Shirya taron wayar da kai kan abinci mai gina jiki a ƙauyuka sittin.
Samar da babura huɗu don ɗaukar marasa lafiya zuwa asibiti.
1) Ƙara yawan ungozoma da aka horar a yankin Tahoua.
2) Haɗa shirin abinci mai gina jiki da shirin allurar rigakafi.
3) Ƙarfafa haɗin kai da rediyon al'umma don isar da saƙonni.
4) Neman sabbin abokan hulɗa don ɗaukar nauyin motocin ɗaukar marasa lafiya.

furniture: Ƙungiya mai zaman kanta · Quartier Koira Kano, Yamai, Nijar · lafiyatare@ngo.example
notes: Annual report of a community-health NGO, written in Hausa with an English summary. Hausa uses the hooked letters ɓ ɗ ƙ and the apostrophe in 'yan / 'ya'ya. On page 1 a Hausa summary box and an English summary box stand side by side: read the Hausa box completely, then the English box. The beneficiaries table has a total row (Jimla). The activity list is CSS-bulleted; the recommendations list has typed markers "1)" ... in the text. Footer line and page number ("Shafi n na N") are CSS page-margin boxes in Segoe UI.
